content:
# Missions Workflow Context

> **Context Recovery**: Run `luuna-missions prime` after compaction, clear, or new session

# Session Close Protocol

Before saying "done", run this checklist:

```
[ ] 1. Close completed issues:    luuna-missions close <id1> <id2> ...
[ ] 2. File remaining work:       luuna-missions create --title "..." --from <id>
[ ] 3. Run quality gates:         go test ./...
[ ] 4. Commit issue changes:      luuna-missions sync
```

Then push or open a PR as the repo's conventions say.

## Core Rules
- **Track durable work in missions** (`luuna-missions create`, `luuna-missions ready`, `luuna-missions close`), not markdown task files. In-session checklists (TodoWrite) are fine.
- **Claim before starting**: `luuna-missions update <id> --claim` (atomic; fails if someone else has it)
- **Never hand-edit `.luuna/missions/*.jsonl`**: `luuna-missions` commands lock, validate, and dedup; hand edits skip all three

## Essential Commands

### Finding Work
- `luuna-missions ready` — Show issues ready to work (no blockers)
- `luuna-missions list --status=in_progress` — Active work
- `luuna-missions show <id> [<id2> ...]` — Detailed issue view
- `luuna-missions search <query>` — Full-text search

### Creating & Updating
- `luuna-missions create --title="..." --type=task|bug|feature|epic --priority=2` — New issue (priority 0-4, 0=critical)
- `luuna-missions update <id> --claim --as <agent>` — Claim work atomically (fails if already taken)
- `luuna-missions create --title="..." --from <id>` — File work discovered while on <id> (non-blocking provenance)
- `luuna-missions close <id1> <id2> ...` — Close one or more issues

### Dependencies & Blocking
- `luuna-missions dep add <issue> <depends-on>` — Add dependency
- `luuna-missions blocked` — Show all blocked issues

### Labels
- `luuna-missions label add <id> bug ui` — Add labels to an issue
- `luuna-missions list --label=bug` — Filter by label

### Sync & Project Health
- `luuna-missions sync` — Stage and commit .luuna/missions/ changes
- `luuna-missions doctor` — Check for data integrity issues

### Planning
Use `luuna-missions plan` when work is large or ambiguous; submit spawns one child seed per step. For small, well-scoped tasks, just `luuna-missions create`.

- `luuna-missions plan prompt <seed-id>` — Emit prompt JSON for the LLM to fill
- `luuna-missions plan submit <seed-id> --plan <file>` — Validate + spawn children
- `luuna-missions plan show <pl-id>` — Sections, children, nested sub-plans

## Common Workflows

**Starting work:**
```bash
luuna-missions ready                    # Find available work
luuna-missions show <id>                # Review issue details
luuna-missions update <id> --claim      # Claim it
```

**Completing work:**
```bash
luuna-missions close <id1> <id2> ...    # Close all completed issues at once
luuna-missions sync                     # Stage + commit .luuna/missions/
```
